description: Side-by-side comparison of position-based (EDE) vs. cell-based (Levin) algotype binding

hypothesis.ede: Algotypes tied to positions → constant aggregation during sorting
hypothesis.levin: Algotypes bound to cells → dynamic aggregation during sorting

metrics.aggregation_pct: Percentage of cells with ≥1 same-algotype neighbor
metrics.sortedness_pct: Percentage of cells in correct final position
metrics.aggregation_delta: Absolute difference between EDE and Levin aggregation
